correctness.rationale: Direct algebra reconstructs both equations (2.11a)–(2.11b). This analytically proves the three-parameter classification including all edges, independently of rational tests. verify.py completed 1200 exact equation/criterion tests, 9999 rational boundary tests and the rational witness.

originality.rationale: The exact source algorithm and sufficient spatial MBP bound are prior work. An implication-level inspection of its full preprint, earlier CN/AB methods and a 2024 method survey reveals no theorem implying the exact homogeneous necessary/sufficient polynomial, reentrant time-step window or large-first-stabilization zero-second-stabilizer regime. Relevant scientific record search did not surface direct coverage; this remains a qualified best-knowledge comparison, not global uniqueness.
residual_risks: An equivalent algebraic classification may occur in unindexed invariant-region or SSP theory under a different parameterization.
The complete 2020 Hou–Leng text and the complete 2024 Hao–Lee–Xu–Xu text were not inspected; their distinct scheme descriptions make direct coverage less plausible but do not prove impossibility.
A scalar necessary bound does not imply a full spatial finite-difference sufficient bound; this remains explicitly outside the claim.

value.rationale: The motivated object is the original method's physical maximum-bound invariant domain. A sharp all-parameter scalar boundary is a necessary obstruction for any full periodic/Neumann spatial implementation, and the two disconnected step-safety regions show a substantive nonmonotone phenomenon not captured by prior sufficient numerical bounds. The critical first stabilization 4+2sqrt2 and exact second-stabilization curve give meaningful test and design benchmarks.
